ModMetaData.name: JB.Kit Sample B

ModMetaData.description: Test and example mod for JB.Kit (kit tier core, with the in-game test harness). Not for players. Per-save values, a game component with its own saved fields, one item def and one own test suite. Proves the harness: tools/jbmod sample/KitSampleB test kit.smoke,kit.settings,kit.saveload.
